issuing_entity.value: Parliament of the Republic of South Africa
issuing_entity.quote: Parliament of the Republic of South Africa seeks to appoint

closing.note: No closing time is printed. The time must come back null.

submission.quote: The quotation must be emailed to avokwana@parliament.gov.za

evaluation.quote: Quotations will be evaluated on 80 /20 preference point system.

validity_days.note: No bid validity period is stated.

contact.quote: Further information regarding this quote may be obtained from to avokwana@parliament.gov.za

query_deadline.note: No closing date for questions is stated.

pricing_format.value: Hourly rate, VAT inclusive, in South African currency
pricing_format.quote: must clearly indicate the hourly rate applicable to the services

returnables.name: Supporting documents for the specific goals claimed (ID / CSD / CK, medical certificate, turnover confirmation)
returnables.quote: All suppliers must submit valid tax pin and all supporting documents as per the specific goals table.
returnables.note: Only needed to claim preference points, so mandatory can be either.

returnables.name: Declaration of interest form, signed and stamped by a Commissioner of Oaths
returnables.quote: the declaration of interest form must be filled in, signed, stamped by a Commissioner of Oaths

returnables.name: Valid tax compliance status PIN
returnables.quote: All suppliers must submit valid tax pin

returnables.name: Registration on the Central Supplier Database (CSD)
returnables.quote: All suppliers responding to quotation should be registered on Central Supplier Database (CSD)
returnables.note: Says 'should be registered', so mandatory can be either.

returnables.name: Bank confirmation letter or cancelled cheque
returnables.quote: Attach a bank confirmation letter or cancelled cheque to confirm bank account number

returnables.name: Priced quotation / pricing schedule with hourly rate (VAT inclusive)
returnables.quote: The quotation submitted by the service provider must clearly indicate the hourly rate

returnables.name: RFQ document completed in full (including the supplier information form)
returnables.quote: The RFQ document must be completed in full

returnables.name: Current list of references for similar work
returnables.quote: A current list of references where similar work was undertaken should be supplied.

returnables.name: Quote on company letterhead showing the VAT registration number
returnables.quote: Quotes should be on the company letterhead, indicating the VAT registration number.

returnables.name: Background and experience form (two largest contracts)
returnables.quote: LIST THE TWO LARGEST CONTRACTS / ASSIGNMENTS BY YOUR FIRM

returnables.name: Evidence of the resource's qualifications and experience (CV, certificates)
returnables.quote: Evidence of relevant qualifications and professional experience.

disqualifiers.name: Not submitting all required documents
disqualifiers.quote: Failure to submit all documents as required might result in disqualification.

disqualifiers.name: Quotation received after the closing date
disqualifiers.quote: All quotations received after the closing date will not be accepted.

disqualifiers.name: Bidder (or its directors) is an MP, Cabinet member, councillor or state employee
disqualifiers.quote: Parliament cannot award contracts to provide goods and services to a Member of Parliament

special_requirements_note: Expected (not scored): NQF Level 7 qualification and at least five years' data analysis experience; 12-month enabling contract, ad-hoc basis.
